meta.title: What's new in Stormlog
meta.description: Stormlog 0.4.3 adds inference diagnostics, SLO comparison, MLX support, and OpenTelemetry export. Compare inference runs, diagnose performance regressions, and export metrics and traces to observability backends.

updates.title: Diagnose and compare inference run performance
updates.summary: New infer diagnose and infer compare commands identify slow windows in inference artifacts and compare two runs to detect regressions. Capture server metadata and verify runs are comparable before analysis.
highlights: Run infer diagnose to explain slow windows with incident evidence
Compare two inference arms with infer compare for A/B testing
Verify server descriptions and run comparability before analysis
Score qualification against injected ground truth for fault injection
Run inference experiment plans on fresh verified servers
updates.code:
# Diagnose slow windows in an inference artifact
stormlog infer diagnose --root ./watch --artifact run1.msgpack

# Compare two inference runs to detect regressions
stormlog infer compare --root ./compare --artifact-a run1.msgpack --artifact-b run2.msgpack

updates.title: Export metrics and traces to observability backends
updates.summary: Stormlog now exports Prometheus metrics during inference profiling and sends spans to OpenTelemetry collectors or files. Monitor inference server health and correlate profile data with external observability platforms.
highlights: Export Prometheus metrics while inference profiles run
Send spans to OpenTelemetry collector or file for trace analysis
Report collect-server health to Prometheus for monitoring
Bounded export building blocks for extensibility
Hardened span close and service identity tracking
updates.code:
# Profile inference with Prometheus metrics export
stormlog infer watch --root ./watch --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --prometheus-url http://127.0.0.1:9090

# Send spans to OpenTelemetry collector
stormlog infer watch --root ./watch --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --otel-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:4317

updates.title: Profile MLX inference with Metal acceleration
updates.summary: New MLX framework support adds lazy Metal runtime profiling, CLI capture, and TUI integration. Profile text and audio inference on Apple Silicon with full artifact analysis.
highlights: Lazy Metal runtime profiling and passive session tracking
CLI capture and offline analysis for MLX inference
Text and audio profiling with scoped server evidence
TUI integration for artifact browsing and analysis
updates.code:
# Capture MLX inference profile with Metal acceleration
stormlog infer capture --framework mlx --model meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat --root ./mlx-profile

# Analyze captured MLX artifact
stormlog infer analyze --artifact mlx-profile/artifact.msgpack

updates.title: Reduce inference artifact size with compact contexts
updates.summary: Inference contexts are now compacted to significantly reduce artifact disk footprint while preserving diagnostic information for slow-window analysis and comparison.
highlights: Compact inference contexts to reduce storage overhead
Maintain full diagnostic capability for diagnosis and compare
Measured savings documented on production audit workloads
updates.code:
# Profile inference; artifacts use compact contexts automatically
stormlog infer watch --root ./watch --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000

# Verify artifact size reduction
ls -lh watch/artifacts/
